feature_subset_rationale: In PHIUSIL every legitimate URL is a bare https://domain with no path while phishing URLs carry paths, and the only path-bearing legitimate source used for augmentation (MURL) stores no scheme, so the conjunction 'https AND non-empty path' occurred only in the phishing class. Features that encode URL shape (path, query, length) were therefore removed, chosen by scripts/ablate_url_features.py (reports/url_feature_ablation.md).
model_selection: Pipeline family fixed to LogisticRegression by the ablation experiment; validation F1 alone would have selected RandomForest, which is not used because its false-positive rate on independent legitimate URLs is ~98%.
trained_on: data/processed/urls_aug_train.csv (+val for the final fit): PHIUSIL domain-isolated pool + MURL benign/legitimate/phishing
never_trained_on: URL-Phish (Dataset E, untouched final external set)
threshold_selection: domain-held-out 15% slice of the augmented pool (urls_aug_val.csv)

augmented_pool_stats.purpose: Augmented training pool: PHIUSIL domain-isolated pool + MURL benign/legitimate/phishing. MURL supplies realistic path-bearing legitimate URLs that PHIUSIL lacks.
not_used_for_training: URL-Phish (Dataset E) - untouched final external set
